verdict.rationale: Stripe's Workbench includes a built-in API Explorer for visually exploring API resources and building API calls, plus an in-browser Shell with tab completion that runs real API requests against a sandbox. This covers the core of interactive, runnable API exploration. The supporting Workbench overview confirms it is a first-party tool for building, testing and debugging integrations. missing for 10: evidence that the public API reference docs themselves embed runnable examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API Explorer experience, and detail beyond the summary description of the explorer.
